An Original Novel'' |author=[[Adam Christopher]] |cover artist= |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Del Rey]] |early release= |release date=Canceled |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=*Hardcover{{Amazon|url=Mandalorian-Original-Novel-Star-Wars/dp/059335561X|text=The Mandalorian Original Novel (Star Wars)}} {{C|Hardcover}} *eBook |pages=336 |isbn=9780593355619 |isbn2= |isbn3= |audiobook=[[The Mandalorian: An Original Novel (audiobook)|Audiobook]] |timeline= |series=[[The Mandalorian publishing program|''The Mandalorian'' publishing program]] |preceded by= |followed by= }} {{Quote|…we're keeping things under wraps – including the title, synopsis, and cover. But that does mean I get one of those cool and mysterious Cover Not Final placeholders.|Adam Christopher|{{WebCite|url=http://www.adamchristopher.co.uk/index.php/2020/06/30/1264|text=Star Wars: The Mandalorian: An Original Novel – coming December 2020|date=2020-06-30|archivedate=20200714023300|nolive=1}}}} '''''The Mandalorian: An Original Novel''''' was a planned [[canon]] novel to be written by [[Adam Christopher]] and published by [[Del Rey]], based on the [[2019]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''.{{Twitter|DelRayStarWars|status/1369332524288212997|[[Del Rey]]|quote=Due to the ever-expanding world of The Mandalorian, we will no longer be publishing THE MANDALORIAN ORIGINAL NOVEL at this time, as the story continues to unfold on screen.|archivedate=20210309180724}} Announced on [[June 30]], [[2020]], as part of [[The Mandalorian publishing program|''The Mandalorian''{{'s}} publishing program]],{{SW|url=news/the-mandalorian-publishing-program-revealed-exclusive|text=''The Mandalorian'' Publishing Program Revealed - Exclusive}} it was originally scheduled for release on [[December 1]] of that year,{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/669179/the-mandalorian-original-novel-star-wars-by-adam-christopher/9780593355619|text=The Mandalorian Original Novel (Star Wars)}} before being delayed to [[November 2]], [[2021]]. The novel was cancelled by Del Rey on [[March 9]], 2021, due to the "ever-expanding world" of the series, but the publisher stated that they were already working on a new novel with Christopher,{{Twitter|DelRayStarWars|status/1369332525005475847|[[Del Rey]]|quote=We love working with author Adam Christopher (@ghostfinder) and are already working with him on a different book. We're excited to share details with you in the future.|archivedate=20210415092507}} later revealed as ''[[Shadow of the Sith]]''.{{SW|url=news/new-books-revealed|text=New Books Starring Luke and Lando, Obi-Wan and Anakin, and More Revealed – Exclusive}}
